text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The race ended with Wonder Acute's 
victory. Hokko Tarumae declared to Wonder 
Acute that next time, she would be the one 
to win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, you tell her that you want to keep 
running together to take on Copano Rickey 
and the others. Wonder Acute responds to 
those feelings with resolve.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae declared she would win both 
the "Champions Cup" and "Tokyo Daishoten" 
to claim the top of dirt racing. The crowd 
went wild at her words!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later. Smart Falcon came to thank her 
Trainer. She shared that when she had been 
completely burned out, Hokko Tarumae had 
reignited the fire within her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And Smart Falcon announced her return to 
racing. Heading toward the showdown with 
her— Hokko Tarumae takes on the Champions 
Cup!
